scope: Spline kinematic-sampling sub_z_5, 3D BC_RC_Bayesian only, on a copy of alternatives/spline/sub_z_5/histograms.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. Bayesian, RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: spline. start=auto: the BC_RC keys these 452 histograms select have median B width 0.17 and only 5 are narrower than 0.05, and the C median width is 0.10 with 10 narrower than 0.05, so those windows are not tight. 305 of 452 leave B unlimited. The run-local guide started as Prepare_Next_Iteration/Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_from_Spline.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 refit all 452 histograms with the run-local copy of the universal spline file and the corrected filled-window range. 451 selected spline keys match the manual keys that made the stored fit, so those histograms did not move. (Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_24) is the spline 3D-BC key rather than the tighter manual key, and that pass lowered its chi-squared onto this histogram's cosine. Pass 2 opened only the histograms whose own cosine was outside the guide or was stuck in the rough-start window. It did not copy nominal parameters. JSON still has 452 bins. 17 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is higher by more than 0.05. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) was stored at the second-pass edge B=-0.045 from the legacy BC limits [-0.03, 0.05] and C [0, 0.1]. It is kept at B=-0.135125, statistical error 0.101193, C=-0.060804, error 0.040346, chi-squared 3.874, NDF 13.0, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. That is this histogram's cosine, not the nominal BC B=-0.116016 and not the acceptance B=-0.125191.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved: (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_4) B=-0.222826 versus nominal -0.162398, shift -0.060427; (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_8) B=-0.063828 versus nominal -0.012483, shift -0.051346; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_15) B=-0.117126 versus nominal -0.068145, shift -0.048982; (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_6) B=-0.299069 versus nominal -0.347901, shift +0.048832; (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_7) B=-0.026424 versus nominal -0.075000, shift +0.048576; (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_4) B=-0.256595 versus nominal -0.209932, shift -0.046664. Bins whose unconstrained cosine does not lower chi-squared by more than about 1, other than the pinned (1, 8) window, stay on the spline guide. Collapsed parameter errors that remain are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and they are not added to the systematic budget. Excluded sector pairs were not put back. Missing comparisons were not filled with zero. The z subdivision source was not removed. Remaining collapsed or spike notes: (Q2_y_Bin_12)-(z_pT_Bin_24) C_error_collapsed; (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_17) C_error_collapsed; (Q2_y_Bin_8)-(z_pT_Bin_30) C_error_collapsed; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_9) B_error_collapsed; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_9) C_error_collapsed; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_10) C_error_collapsed; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_26) isolated_spike; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) isolated_spike.
unresolved: No retained bin is still more than 1 chi-squared above its own unconstrained cosine, so another guide change would not help. The remaining high chi-squared is the histogram shape. Bins with reduced chi-squared at or above 3 after the retained fit: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) 3.207 (chi2 67.346, NDF 21.0). Isolated spikes that the cosine already follows: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) pull 7.08 at 352 deg, fraction 0.75; (Q2_y_Bin_14)-(z_pT_Bin_12) pull 4.05 at 352 deg, fraction 0.62; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_26) pull 4.03 at 352 deg, fraction 0.50. why_retained: Pass 2 is kept because every histogram chi-squared is at least as low as the stored fit, 17 are lower by more than 0.05, and the curves follow each sub_z_5 histogram. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) is no longer pinned at B=-0.045. The nominal value was not imposed. Near-zero parameter errors that remain are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic.
